mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (historical 25th percentile) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% for 2 months) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 6mo MA) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with unemployment below 4.0% and monthly payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs, the strong labor market fuels consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high housing starts (HOUST) relative to historical averages indicate strong residential construction activity, which supports economic growth and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 5-year moving average over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110, it signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 110 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 3.0%) indicates a dovish monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates and inflation risk, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and CPIAUCSL < 3.0%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
